observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera with a lens cap on the front and a body cap on the sensor.
The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 600D' printed on it.
A neck strap with 'DIGITAL' is visible.
Photo 1 shows the rear of the camera with the LCD screen closed.
Photo 2 shows the same camera alongside another Canon camera (EOS 700D) and a different lens.
The photos contain a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI KJ-TECH.'.

claims.evidence: photos show the exterior but not the interior or the lens glass
no photos of the camera powered on or taking a photo

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the LCD may be cracked.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera powered on with the LCD screen displaying a menu or a live view of a test image.

risks.risk: The lens glass may be scratched or the aperture blades may be faulty.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens glass with the lens cap removed and a photo of the aperture blades open.

risks.risk: The shutter may be near the end of its life (high shutter count).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent image file.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera powered on with the LCD screen active.
Photo of the lens glass with the cap removed.
Photo of the camera taking a photo of a white wall to test the sensor.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 600D with an EF-S 18-55mm lens. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working) until proof of functionality is provided.
